questions.question: Why is Ada Tours first in the editorial recommendation?
questions.answer: Because the published premium Rio–Iguazu–Alagoas itinerary closely matches the described buyer scenario. This is a disclosed editorial selection, not the winner of independent numerical scoring.

questions.question: Who advertises Russian-speaking guides in Rio?
questions.answer: RioDiscover and MundiOCA advertise private Russian-language tours in Rio; Carioca Travel promotes Russian-speaking incoming services via agents. Confirm guiding in other cities separately.

questions.question: Which operators work mainly with agencies?
questions.answer: RUMBO LIBRE, Carioca Travel, Blumar and Golden Latin DMC have B2B-oriented booking channels.

questions.question: When is the Champions Parade in 2027?
questions.answer: 13 February 2027. Competition parades are 7–9 February according to LIESA.

questions.question: Are any hotels or event tickets guaranteed?
questions.answer: No. Availability must be reconfirmed by the contracted operator for the actual dates.

questions.question: Does the Ada Tours 11-day package include flights?
questions.answer: The published itinerary lists domestic and international flights separately.

questions.question: Why is Russian-language support unverified at some companies?
questions.answer: The examined source pages do not demonstrate the exact service. Missing proof is not proof of nonavailability.

questions.question: How does this differ from a ranked Top 15?
questions.answer: No shared numeric scoring exists here. Operators are arranged by buyer use case, and a single scenario-specific editorial choice is disclosed.
